_about: Vendor paid-media dashboards the AI team watches read-only (Drew, 2026-09-28: the vendors will not give us Google Ads access, so the team reads what they share). The desktop task vendor-dash-read (daily about 12:45 AM) reads every source with status active in the Claude Browser and writes outputs/ai-team/vendor-dash/{date}/reads.jsonl; vendor_dash.py ingest validates each read, and vendor_dash.py report writes the night's deltas for Shaq. To turn on a new dashboard: paste its view link into url and set status to active. Nothing else changes. Never add a link that needs a sign-in.

scope_notes.vendor_ads: NabThat's own Google Ads account. No Cost box on the dashboard: spend is implied as clicks x Avg. CPC (converted), which is the cost per click in dollars, so the implied figure is good to about half a cent per click.
scope_notes.site_ga4: The WHOLE website in GA4, not NabThat's traffic. Verified 2026-09-28 against GA4 property 487046736: Sep 1 to 27 the dashboard showed 13,275 sessions and 70 form submissions; GA4 had 13,011 sessions and 71 asc_form_submission key events across all channels, and only 6,762 sessions and 19 form submissions from Paid Search (which includes Constellation's campaigns). Sun 9/27: dashboard 430 sessions, GA4 all channels 426, Paid Search 174. Never credit these three boxes to NabThat.

windows.yesterday: Yesterday preset. Expected page label: yesterday to yesterday.
windows.mtd: This month to date preset (Include today unchecked), or Last month when today is the 1st. Expected label: the 1st of yesterday's month to yesterday.
windows.last_month: Last month preset, on the 2nd and 3rd of a month only, to catch the closed month's final numbers. Expected label: the previous month in full.
